sql_data.query: Which product has the highest total order_items.line_total across all statuses? Join products using product_id and return its name and revenue.
sql_data.generated_sql:
SELECT p.product_name,
       SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
sql_data.explanation: The query sums `line_total` for each product, orders the totals descending, and returns the product name with the highest aggregated revenue.
